facts.fact: Egypt's NTRA, with the Central Bank, issued instructions requiring mobile operators to make e-wallet services accessible to people with disabilities, with sign language interpreters, Braille contracts and mobile apps with audio interfaces, voice dictation and screen reader support.
NTRA previously established a sign language complaint service via video calls on its website.
